name: Clickworker
work: Microtasks such as labelling images, categorising short texts, rating AI output, checking search results and product listings, and app-based photo tasks.

KE.title: Sure Media Magazine: online earning platforms tested from Kenya (May 2026)
KE.note: A Kenyan writer who tested Clickworker in 2026 reported earning on it, and Kenya-based workers report pay on Glassdoor. Clickworker sometimes pauses sign-ups in a country when it has enough workers.

availability.note: Clickworker describes a worldwide crowd but publishes no country list we could find, so most African countries are unclear. Kenya is marked accepted based on reports from workers there. Reviewers say the amount of work depends heavily on where you live.

items.text: After registering you fill in your profile and take short qualification tests, which decide which jobs you can do.
Clickworker says it does not set pay for country-specific projects below that country's minimum wage.
Payout options are reported to include PayPal, Payoneer, Airtm, ACH and SEPA, paid weekly, with a minimum of about 10 US dollars for PayPal and about 20 for Payoneer.
Reviewers note that M-Pesa and local bank accounts are not offered.
Work is sometimes rejected without explanation.
Earnings are low and in regions with fewer jobs you may spend more time waiting than working.
